notablePrerequisites: Scuzzback Marauders does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Scuzzback Marauders, adding {C}{C}.
Scuzzback Marauders dies, triggering its persist ability, returning it to the battlefield with no -1/-1 counters due to Bramblewood Paragon.
Repeat.
